profile.name: Haulotte Group SA
profile.summary: Haulotte Group SA, through its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes people and material lifting equipment in Europe, the Asia Pacific, North America, and Latin America. The company offers push-around, vertical masts with or without jib, scissor lifts, rough terrain scissor lifts, articulating booms, rough terrain articulating booms, nacelles articulees tout-terrain, rough terrain telescopic booms, trailers mounted booms, and lightweight self-propelled booms; and specific solutions. It also provides Haulotte Activ'Shield Bar, Haulotte Activ'Lighting System, Haulotte Activ' Screen, Haulotte Stop Emission System, FASTN, Pedestrian Detection Assist, Haulotte Extra Reach, and Haulotte Activ'Energy Management; My Haulotte, a web portal for equipment management and monitoring; My Companion, a web app designed for field operators to access technical and usage information; and Sherpal, a telematics and fleet management solution enabling the monitoring of machine performance, access, and usage. In addition, the company offers preventive maintenance solutions, warranty extensions, and regulatory support; training programs; genuine spare parts; and technical support services. Further, it provides Haulotte Second Life, a refurbishment and modernization solutions; used equipment; and Restart by Haulotte, an industrial refurbishment approach positioned between the traditional used equipment market and new equipment. Additionally, the company engages in equipment rental business. Haulotte Group SA was founded in 1881 and is based in Lorette, France. Haulotte Group SA is a subsidiary of Solem SA.
profile.summary_fr: Haulotte Group SA, à travers ses filiales, fabrique et distribue des équipements de levage de personnes et de matériaux en Europe, en Asie-Pacifique, en Amérique du Nord et en Amérique latine. La société propose des mâts verticaux avec ou sans flèche, des élévateurs à ciseaux, des élévateurs à ciseaux sur terrain accidenté, des bras articulés, des bras articulés sur terrain accidenté, des nacelles articulées tout-terrain, des bras télescopiques sur terrain accidenté, des bras montés sur remorque et des bras automoteurs légers; et des solutions spécifiques. Il fournit également Haulotte Activ'Shield Bar, Haulotte Activ'Lighting System, Haulotte Activ' Screen, Haulotte Stop Emission System, FASTN, Pedestrian Detection Assist, Haulotte Extra Reach et Haulotte Activ'Energy Management ; My Haulotte, un portail Web pour la gestion et la surveillance des équipements ; My Companion, une application Web conçue pour les opérateurs sur le terrain.
